mapper.insert: insert into vm_alarm_suppress_strategy ( alarm_suppress_name, alarm_suppress_type, alarm_source, alarm_if_judge, alarm_judge_result, weather_conditions, period_time, suppress_period_time, suppress_start_time, suppress_end_time, suppress_thresh, alarm_interval, alarm_interval_type, alarm_range_p, alarm_range_t, tenant_id, creater_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, industry_code, app_ver_code,alarm_space_range,alarm_range_status,config_type,begin_recognize_time,begin_recognize_time_type,end_recognize_time,end_recognize_time_type ) values ( #{alarmSuppressName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{alarmSuppressType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{alarmSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{alarmIfJudge,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{alarmJudgeResult,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{weatherConditions,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{periodTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{suppressPeriodTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{suppressStartTime,jdbcType=DATE},#{suppressEndTime,jdbcType=DATE}, #{suppressThresh,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{alarmInterval,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{alarmIntervalType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{alarmRangeP,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{alarmRangeT,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tenantId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createrBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now(), #{updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} , #{industryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{appVerCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{alarmSpaceRange}, #{alarmRangeStatus},#{configType},#{beginRecognizeTime},#{beginRecognizeTimeType},#{endRecognizeTime},#{endRecognizeTimeType})
mapper.select: SELECT id, alarm_suppress_name, alarm_suppress_type, alarm_source, alarm_if_judge, alarm_judge_result, weather_conditions, period_time, suppress_period_time, suppress_start_time, suppress_end_time, suppress_thresh, alarm_interval, alarm_interval_type, alarm_range_p, alarm_range_t, tenant_id, status, creater_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, delete_flag, alarm_space_range, alarm_range_status, config_type,begin_recognize_time,begin_recognize_time_type,end_recognize_time,end_recognize_time_type FROM vm_alarm_suppress_strategy WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.sql:
select DISTINCT ss.id, ss.alarm_suppress_name, ss.alarm_suppress_type, ss.alarm_source, ss.alarm_if_judge, ss.alarm_judge_result, ss.weather_conditions, ss.period_time, ss.suppress_period_time, ss.suppress_thresh, ss.alarm_interval, ss.alarm_interval_type, ss.alarm_range_p, ss.alarm_range_t, ss.tenant_id, ss.status, ss.creater_by, ss.create_time, ss.update_by, t.tenant_name, ss.update_time, ss.delete_flag, ss.industry_code, ss.app_ver_code, ss.config_type, i.industry_name from vm_alarm_suppress_strategy ss left join sys_tenant_info t on t.tenant_id = ss.tenant_id left join sys_industry_conf i on i.industry_code = ss.industry_code and i.accept_node =#{localNode}
left join vm_alarm_device_suppress d on d.alarm_suppress_id = ss.id and d.delete_flag='0'
left join vm_alarm_type_suppress ty on ty.alarm_suppress_id = ss.id and ty.delete_flag='0'
where ss.delete_flag = '0'
mapper.select:
SELECT id, alarm_suppress_name, alarm_suppress_type, alarm_source, alarm_if_judge, alarm_judge_result, weather_conditions, period_time, suppress_period_time, suppress_start_time, suppress_end_time, suppress_thresh, alarm_interval, alarm_interval_type, alarm_range_p, alarm_range_t, tenant_id, status, creater_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, industry_code, delete_flag, alarm_space_range, alarm_range_status FROM vm_alarm_suppress_strategy WHERE delete_flag ='0' AND status = '0'
and id in
#{strategyId}
order by create_time asc
order by create_time desc
order by update_time asc
order by update_time desc
order by id desc

select distinct id from vm_alarm_suppress_strategy ss LEFT JOIN vm_alarm_device_suppress ds on ds.alarm_suppress_id = ss.id and ds.delete_flag='0' LEFT JOIN vm_alarm_type_suppress ts on ts.alarm_suppress_id = ss.id and ts.delete_flag='0' where ss.status = '0' and ss.delete_flag = '0'
and ts.type_value = #{req.alarmType}
and ( (ds.device_code=#{req.deviceCode} and ts.type_value = #{req.alarmType} and ss.alarm_suppress_type = '1,2') or (ds.device_code=#{req.deviceCode} and ss.alarm_suppress_type = '1') or (ts.type_value = #{req.alarmType} and ss.alarm_suppress_type = '2') )
( ss.tenant_id = #{customer.tenantId} and ss.industry_code = #{customer.industryCode} )
select count(1)+1 from vm_alarm_area_suppress where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and delete_flag ='1'

SELECT IF(a.alarm_suppress_name <> 0, concat('告警压制策略', MAX(CAST(a.alarm_suppress_name AS SIGNED)) + 1), '告警压制策略1') FROM ( SELECT SUBSTRING( alarm_suppress_name, 7 ) AS alarm_suppress_name FROM vm_alarm_suppress_strategy WHERE alarm_suppress_name LIKE '告警压制策略%' AND delete_flag = '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND industry_code = #{industryCode} ) a

SELECT IF(a.area_name <> 0, concat('屏蔽区域', MAX(CAST(a.area_name AS SIGNED)) + 1), '屏蔽区域1') FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT REGEXP_SUBSTR ( area_name, '[0-9]+$' ) AS area_name, dev_name FROM vm_alarm_area_suppress WHERE delete_flag = '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND device_code = #{deviceCode} ) a
